2	
3	
4	def problem(status, title, detail=None):
5	    body = {"type": "about:blank", "title": title, "status": status}
6	    if detail:
7	        body["detail"] = detail
8	    resp = jsonify(body)
9	    resp.status_code = status
10	    resp.mimetype = "application/problem+json"
11	    return resp
